newsitem.title: USA: Northern States files for 4 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Northern States files for 4 mln shares.

text.p: Northern States Power Co filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to four million common shares.
Of the four million shares to be offered, 3.2 million will be sold in the United States and the remaining 800,000 shares will be sold in an international offering, the company said.
Underwriters for the offering, Merrill Lynch & Co., Goldman Sachs & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc, Dain Bosworth Inc and Piper Jaffray, have an over-allotment option of up to 600,000 shares.

Northern States said it will use the proceeds from the sale for general corporate purposes, including retiring $100 million of first mortgage bonds, funding construction programs and repaying short-term debt.
After the offering, the Minneapolis-based electric and gas utility said it will have 73,292,619 shares outstanding.
